comments.text: Bailey can you PLEASE do a video on the GATE program for schoolchildren? The gifted and talented education program appears to have ties to MK Ultra and may even be an extension of it. It's top secret and most of the documents on it are still top secret. How can it be legal for them to have a top secret program that they're running on the general public, LET ALONE CHILDREN? Many gifted kids, myself included, can't remember much of what happened in the program. I used to get visions of a kaleidoscope in my eyes as a child, and I just found out that's connected to the GATE program. Specific dreams we all tended to have, specific fears. They gave us "hearing tests" that were guided meditations and this specific pink drink that was chalky like Pepto bismol mixed with tums. We don't know what the drink did to us, if it was meant to stifle or grow us. Exactly one document has been declassified as far as I know, and I think it was actually about an adjacent program. GATE kids are asking what happened to us? And piecing together our memories... People speculate they were using government tactics to induce memory loss given just HOW many of us do not remember. You would do this topic so much justice. I'm actually here searching to see if you'd already done a video on the GATE program. It seemed so intuitive, exactly the type of topic you'd pick.. I know you'll fall down this rabbit hole if you start looking
